name: americas-news-digest
description: News digest focused on North and South America with fan-out collection

steps.name: fetch-usa-canada
steps.prompt:
Fetch North American news RSS feeds:

🇺🇸 USA Sources:
- Associated Press Top News: https://feeds.ap.org/apnews/top25
- NPR News: https://feeds.npr.org/1001/rss.xml
- Reuters US: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/us

🇨🇦 Canada Sources:
- CBC Top Stories: https://www.cbc.ca/cmlink/rss-topstories
- Global News Canada: https://globalnews.ca/feed/
- Toronto Star: https://www.thestar.com/rss.xml

Extract top 3-5 recent stories per source. Include: headline, brief summary, category (politics/business/tech/sports), source. Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-latin-america
steps.prompt:
Fetch Latin American news RSS feeds:

🇲🇽 Mexico:
- Mexico News Daily: https://mexiconewsdaily.com/feed/
- El Universal Mexico: https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/rss.xml

🇧🇷 Brazil:
- The Rio Times: https://riotimesonline.com/feed/
- BBC Brazil (if available via BBC feeds)

🇦🇷 Argentina:
- Buenos Aires Times: https://www.batimes.com.ar/feed

🇨🇴 Colombia:
- Colombia Reports: https://colombiareports.com/feed/

Extract top 3-5 recent stories per source. Note: Some sources may be in Spanish/Portuguese - extract what you can. Include: headline, source country. Return structured list.

steps.name: format-americas-digest
steps.prompt:
Create an Americas-focused news digest for Discord.

**NORTH AMERICA (USA & Canada):**
{{north_america}}

**LATIN AMERICA:**
{{latin_america}}

FORMAT:
```
🌎 **Americas News Digest — {date}**

**🇺🇸 United States**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source: AP/NPR/Reuters)
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇨🇦 Canada**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source: CBC/Global)
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇲🇽 Mexico**
• [Headline] — Summary (Source)
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇧🇷 Brazil, 🇦🇷 Argentina, 🇨🇴 Colombia**
• [Headline] — Summary (Country flag)
• [Headline] — Summary

_Covering the Americas — OpenFang Regional News_
```

Select the most significant stories. Keep under 2000 characters. Include country flags.
